//RepoAllowlist: The repos any run may target (owner/name). M3 un-binds GitHub tooling from a single startup repo; a run against a repo not listed here is refused before any tool runs. This is a policy control, operator-owned — add repos deliberately. `owner/*` allows a whole owner for run-targeting; note that cross-repo code search scopes to EXACT owner/name entries, so list a repo explicitly if agents should be able to search it.
